meta.title: Update remotion.dev/convert to Tailwind 4
meta.body_summary: Upgrade packages/convert to Tailwind CSS v4.1.1 with new Vite plugin and CSS-based configuration, claiming better performance and alignment with promo-pages.

perf_labels.notes: Copilot migrated Tailwind 4; maintainer pushed several fixes then closed PR without merge, no performance evidence.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: Small-to-medium edit by absolute volume, spread across 18 files with most changes in pnpm-lock.yaml and config. Closed without merge after maintainer manual fixes.

review_details.concern_detail: No formal review provided; maintainer committed fixes to the branch but did not leave review text.
review_details.performance_claim: Tailwind 4 provides improved performance and builds.
review_details.rejection_signals: Maintainer closed PR without merge after applying manual fixes; no explicit rejection reason.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Tailwind migration required manual fixes for types, vite config, and tsconfig; maintainer had to intervene extensively before closing the PR, indicating that the agent could not independently deliver a complete, working upgrade in the repo's context.

detection_detail.code_reading: Maintainer reviewed build output, pushed fixes for TypeScript errors and config mismatches.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No benchmark or before/after metrics; only narrative claim of improved performance.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: Maintainer committed fixes for type errors and configuration issues within the PR branch, but ultimately closed the PR without merging.

core_change_summary.description: Upgrade packages/convert to Tailwind CSS v4.1.1: replace @tailwind directives with @import, remove tailwind.config.ts, add @tailwindcss/vite plugin, and update CSS to use @theme inline.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Maintainer added commits to fix types, update other packages' dependencies, and tweak tsconfig, likely unrelated to the Tailwind upgrade core.
change_trajectory: Copilot initial commit: Tailwind 4 upgrade in packages/convert.
Maintainer commits: 'fix types', 'fix', 'update vite', 'aha', 'Update tsconfig.json' addressing build issues.

review_signals.summary: Vercel bot posted deployment status for remotion and bugs projects.

collaboration_trajectory: Copilot opened PR with Tailwind 4 migration for packages/convert.
No formal review; maintainer JonnyBurger pushed multiple follow-up commits to fix types, vite, and tsconfig.
PR closed without merge after ~15.6 hours.
